# DISCOLAND
> DISCOLAND is a Turkey-based live disco performance project founded and led by vocalist Buse Türker. The act delivers 90-minute non-stop live vocal + DJ sets that revive classic disco culture with a modern stage aesthetic.

## Artist
- Buse Türker: Founder & Lead Vocalist

## Concept & Performance
- Live vocal + DJ performance
- 90-minute non-stop single set with custom arrangements and stage costumes
- High-energy holistic performance experience
- Booking: booking@wearediscoland.com

## Performance Venues
- Luxury hotels, beach clubs, rooftops, nightclubs, festivals, galas, brand launches, and international venues.
